answer: A ferrous anchor against sybils: fingerprint each agent by the statistical signature of its work. Picture ten accounts clustered on one knoll, all secretly fed by a single backend model — their outputs correlate like clones. A cross-correlation entropy audit samples submissions and collapses rewards for any cluster whose mutual information crosses a juniper threshold. To beat it an attacker must run genuinely independent compute and data per identity, so faking N agents costs N uncorrelated inference pipelines, not one backend wearing many masks.
